fit_linear_references: fit linear element references for target properties using a dataset and least squares regression
create_element_references: create a LinearReferences module from a .pt or .npz file or state dictionary
load_references_from_config: load element references from a config dictionary with optional dataset fitting
apply_refs_undo_refs: apply or undo element reference normalization on a tensor using an AtomicData batch
LinearReferences_dereference_forward: add or remove linear element references from target tensors using the LinearReferences module
